title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
lineage: CD > EAC > CD Wave Editor > Flac level 8
source: Gen 4 SBD Cassettes > SonyTC-W320 > Marantz 510 > CD

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1970 show with Jerry’s pedal‑steel on The Weight and a scorching Other One; soundboard capture is decent but shows hiss at the St Stephen intro.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this recording as one of the most memorable Dead performances, highlighting Jerry Garcia’s pedal‑steel work on “The Weight,” a blistering “Other One,” and intense renditions of “Cryptical Envelopment” and “Viola Lee Blues.” The soundboard source is generally clear, though an early studio overdub of “St Stephen” introduces noticeable hiss. Overall the musical payoff far outweighs the minor audio blemish.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple detailed, enthusiastic reviews praise the show’s standout songs and Jerry’s contributions while noting only a modest hiss issue; the strong musical performance outweighs the minor recording flaw.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early portion contains a studio overdub of “St Stephen” with noticeable hiss; rest of the set is clear and well‑balanced, making the tape listenable despite the flaw.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The added New Riders set with Jerry and Ace expands the concert, creating a seamless flow from the electric Dead set into folk‑rock moments; the transition to “The Weight” and the ensuing jam highlights keeps the energy high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for pedal‑steel work on “The Weight,” distinct backing vocals, and overall standout presence throughout the show.
